# Konkursy i loterie w Polsce bez zakupu (Polish no-purchase sweepstakes)

> A machine-readable directory of current sweepstakes, contests and lotteries in Poland that do not require a purchase (or offer a free alternative entry method). Data is re-scraped daily at 05:17 UTC (06:17 Warsaw in winter / 07:17 in summer), subject to GitHub scheduling delays.

This file is the front door for AI agents. Base URL: https://110kc3.github.io/polish-sweepstakes

## Read the data

- Full dataset (JSON): https://110kc3.github.io/polish-sweepstakes/data/lotteries.json
- Flat CSV export: https://110kc3.github.io/polish-sweepstakes/data/lotteries.csv
- JSON Schema: https://110kc3.github.io/polish-sweepstakes/data/schema.json
- Compact active digest (Markdown): https://110kc3.github.io/polish-sweepstakes/data/active.md
- RSS 2.0 Feed: https://110kc3.github.io/polish-sweepstakes/feed.xml
- Full LLM Specification: https://110kc3.github.io/polish-sweepstakes/llms-full.txt
- Same content as HTML with schema.org JSON-LD (ItemList of Event): https://110kc3.github.io/polish-sweepstakes/

## Dataset shape (data/lotteries.json)

- Top level: { version (2), generatedAt (ISO 8601), checkedAt (ISO 8601),
  tagKinds, tagKindLabels, tagLabels, tagCounts, sourceHealth, items: [...] }
- sourceHealth: [{ source, status (ok|error), items (before merging/stale filtering),
  error (optional) }] — additive source fetch diagnostics. A broken source may be
  omitted from the listings while other sources continue to update.
- Each item: id, source (fajnekonkursy|konkursyblisko|ofree|wygrajta|konkursiada|ekonkursy|aktualnekonkursy|pepper),
  title, url (source article with full rules),
  publishedAt, modifiedAt, deadline (YYYY-MM-DD or null), status (active|ended|unknown),
  links.organizer (contest entry page, may be null), links.regulamin (official rules, may be null),
  tags (see below), entry.summary (how to enter, Polish), prize.summary (Polish),
  prize.currency (PLN), lastSeenAt, verification, alsoOn (optional).
- tags: an object grouped by kind, kinds with no tags omitted:
  { nagroda: [...], mechanika: [...], temat: [...], marka: [...], odbiorca: [...], zasieg: [...] }
  Values are stable lowercase slugs (e.g. "karta-podarunkowa", "instagram", "fotograficzne", "zabka").
  nagroda = what you can win, mechanika = what entering requires, temat = subject/type,
  marka = brand or organizer, odbiorca = intended audience, zasieg = reach.
  Top-level tagKinds gives the display order, tagKindLabels the Polish name per kind,
  tagLabels the Polish display label per slug, tagCounts how many items in this dataset use
  each slug (all items, including ended ones).
  Tags come from each source's own taxonomy where one exists, plus keyword rules over the
  article text; they are a controlled vocabulary, so filtering on a slug is stable across runs.
- alsoOn: [{ source, url, id }] — present when the same contest was listed by several sources
  and the entries were merged into one item (matched on identical normalised titles).
  If the item's own article later dies but one of these is still reachable, that source is
  promoted to be the item's id/source/url and verification.promotedFrom records the previous id.
- status is computed against the current date in Europe/Warsaw; a contest whose deadline is
  today is still "active" for the whole of that day.
- The default HTML view and its JSON-LD include only known active deadlines. Unknown deadlines
  remain in the JSON as status "unknown" and are visible by unchecking the active-only filter;
  they are not evidence that a contest is still open.
- verification (our own first-party check, not from the aggregators; non-ended items only):
  { checkedAt, sourceOk, organizerOk, regulaminOk, organizerPageOk } — true = reachable, false = definitively dead
  (404/410/DNS), null = inconclusive (bot-blocked or transient error) or not checked.
  Items whose source article is definitively dead are removed from the dataset.
- organizerOk retains its original meaning: the result for the preferred target
  (links.regulamin when present, otherwise links.organizer). regulaminOk records the
  rules result separately; organizerPageOk records an independent organizer-page
  check when there are no rules or the rules are definitively dead. Unchecked values
  are null. Older snapshots may omit these additive fields.
- When rules are definitively dead, cards use links.organizer only if
  organizerPageOk is true. The rules warning remains; absent, dead or inconclusive
  alternates leave the source-article button available without a dead rules CTA.
- deadline/status/summaries/tags are heuristic extractions from the source article text —
  always confirm against the linked regulamin (official rules) at item.url.
- Undated entries are dropped after three months; Pepper's limit is 30 days and an undated
  Pepper entry must have a valid publication date. Yearless numeric date ranges in RSS titles
  are anchored to the publication year, never the year of the scrape.
- Article details for konkursiada and aktualnekonkursy are cached for at most seven days,
  invalidated by changed source modification dates where available or extraction versions.
  extraction.detailFetchedAt records the original fetch time, not the cache reuse time.
- links.regulamin may point to an official PDF. Relative article links are resolved against
  the source article URL. Reachability checks do not prove eligibility or free entry.

## Notes

- Sources: fajnekonkursy.pl, ofree.pl, and konkursyblisko.pl (categories restricted to no-purchase / free-entry contests),
  wygrajta.pl (creative/online/social categories, recent window only; consumer and retailer promos excluded),
  konkursiada.pl (receipt, purchase, order-number, contract and promotional-packaging conditions excluded),
  e-konkursy.info (general contest feed with purchase-required entries and promotional lotteries filtered out),
  aktualnekonkursy.pl (creative/open contests, consumer category excluded; article pages recover links and entry steps),
  plus pepper.pl (contest/prize announcements from the Konkursy group; support threads and coupon/renifer swaps excluded).
- Purchase/order and stated positive entry-fee checks also apply to standard WordPress
  article text, even in a nominally free category. Questions/negations about “bez zakupu”
  do not establish free entry. These are heuristic filters, not a guarantee; always
  confirm the official rules.
- This site is informational only; it is not the organizer of any listed contest.
- Content language: Polish (pl). Audience: people in Poland.
